80 PLUS®  GOLD CERTIFIED
Very high operating efficiency
Pure Power 12 850W is certified 80 PLUS Gold with an outstanding efficiency rating of up to 92.7%. The most compelling benefit: lower power consumption, consequently lower costs, and above all a cooler as well as quieter operation. Pure Power 12 850W is always the correct choice for quiet systems and gaming PCs!
FUTURE-PROOF YOUR SYSTEM
Fulfills all ATX 3.1 specifications
Pure Power 12 850W is an ATX 3.1 PSU and comes with both native integration of the 12V-2x6 connector for next-generation PCIe 5.1 graphics cards, and 3 PCIe 6+2-pin connectors for support of current-gen GPUs. This makes the PSU extremely versatile and the perfect choice for powerful systems of today and the ones to come.
THE NEW STANDARD OF POWER
For massive transient loads
Pure Power 12 offers 850W of continuous power with one massive 12V rail. Even if the graphics card demands excessive power for a short time: Pure Power 12 850W handles power excursions up to double its rated power with ease. This ensures reliable operation with the next generation of processors and graphics cards.
EXCEPTIONALLY SILENT OPERATION
Achieved by a silence-optimized be quiet! fan
The exceptionally silent 120mm be quiet! fan is temperature-controlled to strike the best balance between effective cooling and quietness. Airflow-optimized fan blades reduce turbulence, enabling best-in-class quiet functionality.
HIGH-CLASS TECHNOLOGIES
Rock-solid stability
With its LLC topology Pure Power 12 850W provides best-in-class voltage regulation and efficiency. That makes it perfect for building very quiet systems or upgrading gaming and media creation PCs.
HIGH-QUALITY CABLES
For a tidy system
Pure Power 12 850W is certainly an eye-catcher. Motherboard and 12V-2x6 cables are finished with high quality black sleeves. The remaining premium black flat cables simplify installation and keep the system tidy. This results in increased airflow and improved cooling.
“Ever since the first Pure Power, uncountable amounts of it have found their way into the PCs – and most likely hearts – of users worldwide.”
Aaron Licht, Chief Executive Officer
